title: Psychologische aspecten van rheumatoide arthritis 1975-1978
authors: Ploeg, F.A.E. van der, Boeke-Kramer, C.G., Nienhuis, R.L.F., Academisch ziekenhuis Groningen * Groningen (primary investigator)
contributors: Vakgroep klinische psychologie, RUG * Groningen (data collector)
descriptions: Do r.a.-patients have typical characteristics/ to what extent does a longitudinal relation exist between psychological and medical variables. Personality tests / social contacts, relation with parents / medical and social attendance / mental needs / medical data. Background variables: basic characteristics/ household characteristics/ characteristics of parental family/household/ occupation/employment/ education
